stories.title: Donald Trump: Experten zweifeln an Preiswirkung von Putins Diesel-Deal

en.title: Donald Trump: Experts doubt price impact of Putin's diesel deal
en.summary: Three weeks before midterm elections, Trump negotiated an agreement with the Kremlin to import Russian diesel aimed at appeasing voters. Experts view the accord skeptically, particularly because it primarily benefits one side.

stories.title: Liveblog Ukrainekrieg: Trump verkündet Waffenruhe in Ukraine – Russen greifen an

en.title: Ukraine War Liveblog: Trump Announces Ceasefire in Ukraine – Russians Attack
en.summary: Trump announced an energy ceasefire while Kyiv appeared unaware of the declaration. Selenskyj expressed openness to a ceasefire while Ukraine rejected Trump's demand for a new president.

stories.title: USA unter Trump: US-Senatoren kritisieren Trumps Diesel-Deal mit Russland

en.title: USA under Trump: US senators criticize Trump's diesel deal with Russia
en.summary: US senators have criticized a diesel deal between the Trump administration and Russia. The report also notes changes to military exercises with South Korea under the Trump presidency.

stories.title: Donald Trump: Republikanische Senatoren attackieren seinen Diesel-Deal

en.title: Donald Trump: Republican Senators Attack His Diesel Deal
en.summary: Shortly before the midterms, Donald Trump proposed importing 300,000 tons of diesel from Russia, drawing criticism not only from Democrats but also from senior Republican officials.

stories.title: Saudi-Arabien: Huthis greifen erneut Flughäfen mit Raketen an

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Huthis Attack Airports Again With Rockets
en.summary: The Yemeni Huthi militia conducted another attack on Saudi Arabian airports and energy facilities, with authorities reporting injuries and at least one death at King Khalid Airport.

stories.title: Krieg in der Golfregion: Tote bei Angriff auf Flughafen von Riad

en.title: War in the Gulf region: Deaths in attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport in the Gulf region has resulted in fatalities.

stories.title: Keisuke Goto köpft SC Freiburg gegen Schalke an die Spitze

en.title: Keisuke Goto heads SC Freiburg to the top against Schalke
en.summary: SC Freiburg defeated Schalke 04 with a late goal from substitute Keisuke Goto. Freiburg tops the table after matchday five.

stories.title: US-Präsident Trump teilt angebliche "Energie-Waffenruhe" zwischen Ukraine und Russland mit

en.title: US President Trump announces alleged "energy ceasefire" between Ukraine and Russia
en.summary: US President Trump announces an alleged ceasefire on energy infrastructure attacks between Ukraine and Russia.

stories.title: Fußball-Bundesliga: SC Freiburg siegt gegen FC Schalke 04 und ist Tabellenführer

en.title: Bundesliga: SC Freiburg Defeats FC Schalke 04 and Takes First Place
en.summary: SC Freiburg extended their strong season start by defeating Schalke 04 and assuming the league lead, securing victory despite playing with reduced numbers.

stories.title: 2:1 gegen Schalke 04: Freiburg trifft in Unterzahl zum Sieg und ist Tabellenführer

en.title: 2:1 Against Schalke 04: Freiburg Scores While Undermanned to Win and Claim First Place
en.summary: Freiburg established an early lead against Schalke but faced a setback after conceding an equalizer and receiving a red card, then secured victory through substitute goals.

stories.title: Liveblog Irankrieg: Weiterer Angriff auf Flughafen in Riad

en.title: Live blog Iran war: Another attack on airport in Riyadh
en.summary: Saudi aviation authorities reported multiple injuries from an attack on Riyadh airport. A previous attack on Saturday at the airport resulted in 12 deaths, and German Economics Minister Reiche had to postpone her return journey from Riyadh.

stories.title: Gastkommentar: Deutschland gefährdet seinen Vorsprung beim Quanten-Computing

en.title: Guest commentary: Germany risks losing its lead in quantum computing
en.summary: The competition for quantum computing technology extends beyond laboratory research. A German quantum computer manufacturer CEO discusses the critical factors for maintaining competitive advantage in this field.

stories.title: Unionsfraktion: 27-Punkte-Plan an die EU: CDU und CSU fordern billigen Strom für Unternehmen

en.title: Union faction: 27-point plan to the EU: CDU and CSU demand cheap electricity for companies
en.summary: CDU and CSU are pressuring the EU president to promote economic growth and strengthen the EU in global trade. The parliamentary group has presented a detailed demand document focusing on affordable energy costs for businesses.

stories.title: Klimaschutz: Gegen den Trend: EU-Banken fahren Finanzierung von Kohle-Unternehmen deutlich zurück

en.title: Climate protection: Against the trend: EU banks significantly reduce financing of coal companies
en.summary: A new study shows that self-imposed guidelines by EU banks are taking effect in reducing coal company financing. By contrast, financial institutions in China and the United States display a different approach to coal industry funding.

stories.title: Fintechs: Trade Republic macht jetzt über 750 Millionen Euro Umsatz

en.title: Fintechs: Trade Republic now generates over 750 million euros in revenue
en.summary: Germany's most valuable fintech company experienced rapid growth in fiscal year 2024/25, according to a business report obtained by Handelsblatt.

stories.title: Kommentar: Friedrich Merz hat nur noch zwei schlechte Optionen

en.title: Commentary: Friedrich Merz has only two bad options left
en.summary: CDU state premiers are pressuring the chancellor to change course, forcing the party to decide whether to continue supporting his strict reform agenda.
